title: KLCC Snorkels 2024 — Iconic Landmark Lightboxes (Big Tree)
summary: ‘O’ + ‘D’ snorkels up to 535 sq ft/panel; full domination RM982k/6 mo, RM1.836M/12 mo.
description: Big Tree deck (14 pages). Set of curving lightboxes at KLCC base. Surround: Petronas HQ, Maxis, Suria KLCC, Avenue K, Mandarin/Four Seasons/Grand Hyatt, Tropicana/Four Seasons residences. Packages: 4x O +4x D, 12-mo media RM1.5M + production/lighting/SST = RM1.836M; special RM860k media = RM1.121M; 6-mo RM982k. Availability from 01-Jan-25.
